research_rationale: Partial candidate. The complete original establishes six continuing substantive rules, expressly effective as of September 1, 1947, although signed February 27, 1948. Individual four-year appointment eligibility, two-month notice, thirty-day reinstatement and waiver conditions do not set a whole-order calendar sunset. EO12107 expressly substitutes OPM for CSC effective January 1, 1979. EO12292 expressly revokes EO9932 effective February 15, 1981, rather than its February 23 signature date. That establishes termination by the cutoff but does not establish first cessation. The revoker identifies a concrete statutory transition from the incorporated 1946 reinstatement regime to 1980 Act section 310; actual statutory history and continuity are unread. Earlier actual Civil Service Rule III and appointment-system changes also require resolution for the status routes. Named-function searches additionally found narrower overseas-program reinstatement limitations; they are recorded as bounded leads and do not establish a global ending. Accrued competitive status and individual reinstatement rights are not declared invalid. Final search and savings closure are withheld, and provisional no status is unchanged.
